info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Product Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Product Management Retrieval API allows users to fetch detailed information regarding specific product designs based on a given parameter. This endpoint supports business intelligence operations by enabling stakeholders to access product management data efficiently, ensuring informed decision-making. Typical consumers include product managers, marketing teams, and analytics professionals who require real-time access to product specifications and insights. By utilizing this API, businesses can enhance their product offerings and streamline management processes.

get.description: Fetches the details of the specific product design with ID PROD-700045, including associated attributes and specifications.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve detailed information about the product design identified by PROD-700045. Ensure to provide the necessary parameters in the body to get the desired response.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the product details are returned.

GetProductManagementByParam1Request.description: Representation of the request body for the GET operation in the product management design.

GetProductManagementByParam1Response_200.title: Product Response

productCode.description: The unique code identifying the product.

customerSegment.description: The segment of customers for whom the product is intended.

baseCurrency.description: The currency used as the base for the product pricing.

effectiveDate.description: The date from which the product is effective.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the product record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version number of the product record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the product record was last updated.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the response of the product record.

GetProductManagementByParam1Response_200.description: Represents the details of a product retrieved in the response.

ProductMetadata.title: Product Metadata

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier used to correlate related requests and responses.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing of the request took place.

ProductMetadata.description: Contains metadata related to the product response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Authentication method where the client must include a token in the Authorization header. The token should be a JSON Web Token (JWT) that carries the necessary information for authentication.
